summary: Sogen Asahina (1891–1979) was a Buddhist and religious studies scholar who studied at Nihon University and taught Kōun Yamada. He held a post at Kanagawa University.

Sogen Omori (1904–1994) worked in Buddhist studies, religious studies, and philosophy. Educated at Nihon University, he studied under Seisetsu Seki, Bokuo Seki, and Jirokichi Yamada. He served as abbot at Kobo-in, and as professor and president at Hanazono University.

Sogyal Rinpoche (1947–2019) was a scholar of Buddhist studies, religious studies, and Tibetology. He studied at the University of Delhi and the University of Cambridge, as well as under traditional teachers including Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö and Dudjom Jigdral Yeshe Dorje.
Sohanwela Pemarathana is a scholar of Buddhist studies who studied at the National University of Singapore under thesis supervisor Saranindranath Tagore.

Soiku Shigematsu (born 1943) studied at Tokyo University of Foreign Studies, Kyoto University, and the University of Tokyo. He held posts at Shizuoka Women's University, Shizuoka University as professor of English Literature (1975–2001), and Kansai Medical University (2001–2006).
Sojo Hirano (1928–2007) was a Buddhist studies scholar who served as an associate professor at Hanazono University and as shike at Zuigan-ji.

Sokei-an Shigetsu Sasaki (1882–1945) was a Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Tokyo Academy of Fine Arts, California School of Design, and California Institute of the Arts, and with teachers Sōkatsu Shaku, Sōen Shaku, and Richard Partington.

Sokichi Tsuda (1873–1961) was a scholar of history, philosophy, and sinology who studied at Tōkyō Senmon Gakkō. He held posts at the SMR Research Department, Waseda University, and the University of Tokyo.
Sokuo Eto (1888–1958) was a Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Kyoto University and the University of Tokyo. He was a professor at Komazawa University in 1953.

Solomon George FitzHerbert is a scholar of Tibetology and history who earned his doctorate at the University of Oxford. He has held posts as a departmental lecturer at Oxford and as a researcher at the CNRS.

Soma Thera (1898–1960) worked in Buddhist studies. He was educated at St. Benedict's College, Colombo, studied under traditional teacher Jetavana Sayadaw, and was a member of the Servants of the Buddha around 1926.

Somadeva Vasudeva is an Indologist who completed his PhD at the University of Oxford under Alexis Sanderson. He held posts at the French Institute of Pondicherry, Columbia University, and Kyoto University.
Somboon Watana is a scholar of philosophy and Buddhist studies who earned a PhD at Panjab University in 1999 under the supervision of Rekha Jhanji and Dharmanand Sharma.

Somdet Phra Nyanasamvara (1913–2013) was a Buddhist studies and religious studies scholar educated at Wat Bowonniwet Vihara, studying under Vajirayanavangsa and Swami Satyananda Puri. He was abbot of Wat Bowonniwet Vihara and director at Mahamakut Buddhist University.
Somphong Santacitto is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned a master's degree in Buddhist studies at Mahachulalongkornrajavidyalaya University under MA supervisor Phra Suthithammanuwat.

Sonam Chhoki is a scholar of Tibetology and religious studies who earned an MA at Jawaharlal Nehru University and a PhD at SOAS University of London. She has taught history at Samtse College of Education.
Sonam Gyatso (born 1933) is a Tibetology and Buddhist studies scholar who served as a research assistant at the Toyo Bunko and as a professor at the Central Institute of Higher Tibetan Studies.

Sonam Kachru is a scholar of philosophy, Buddhist studies, and Indology. He completed a PhD at the University of Chicago under Dan Arnold and has held posts at the Max Planck Institute and Forum Transregionale Studien.

Sonam Thakchoe is a scholar of philosophy, Buddhist studies, and Tibetology who earned his PhD at the University of Tasmania under Jay L. Garfield and Jeff Malpas, where he also held an academic post.

Sonam Tsering is a Tibetology and Buddhist studies scholar who studied under Gray Tuttle as doctoral supervisor, as well as teachers Janet Gyatso, Leonard van der Kuijp, Samdhong Rinpoche, Lobsang Trinley, Namgyel Khenzur Dawa, and Drepung Khenzur Gyatso.
